description: 한국전력거래소_육지 플러스DR 기준태양광이용률 및 기준수요 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국전력거래소. ㅇ 한국전력거래소는 전력을 생산하는 발전사업자, 전력을 수요지까지 전달하는 송배전사업자, 전력을 구매하여 판매하는 판매사업자, 전력을 사용하는 소비자 등으로 구성되는 전력시장에서 전력의. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국전력거래소. Its tags are 육지, 플러스DR기준태양광이용률, 기준수요, 플러스DR, 수요반응자원. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-06-04 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
